stories.title: 109 affordable homes in Flint get final sign-off after legal agreement
stories.summary: Formal planning permission has been issued for 109 affordable homes at Oakenholt in Flint, after a legal agreement with the developer was completed. Flintshire County Council’s planning committee backed Castle Green Homes’ plans for Quarry Farm, off Leadbrook Drive, in July. stories.title: Three arrests and 55 calls in 24 hours for south Flintshire police
stories.summary: Police officers in south Flintshire dealt with 55 calls for service in 24 hours, including six emergencies attended on blue lights, according to the local neighbourhood policing team. The figures were posted on Saturday morning, 21 November, by North Wales Police’s South Flintshire team on its Facebook page. Three people were arrested during the period.

stories.title: Bluetongue cases in Wales reach 516, including seven in Flintshire
stories.summary: Bluetongue has been confirmed at seven premises in Flintshire since the disease season began in July, government figures show. Bluetongue is a virus spread by midges which affects animals including sheep and cattle. Across Wales there have been 516 cases this season, compared with 24 in the whole of the previous season.
